_purpose: Every committed run of the shelf database on the IMDb suite, so the analysis documents can cite a named file for each number. The file `imdb_shelf.json` holds only the newest run, so the earlier runs were archived here when they were overwritten.
_box_state_note: The box carries other engines and containers during the engine matrix. The idle control run used the same binary and the same bundle with the box idle.

spread_across_the_four_runs._note: The same binary and the same bundle produce this spread. The engine comparison must state which run it uses.

bundle_setup_cost_ms._note: Two committed measurements of the same bundle build. The 51,100 ms figure is the benchmark number used across the analysis documents. The 112,721 ms figure is a forced full rebuild measured on 2026-10-22 with the per-stage times names 11,440 ms, ratings 548 ms, basics 11,168 ms, principals 89,565 ms.
